summary: The school district emphasizes the importance of E-Rate funding for maintaining reliable internet infrastructure and education access.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools would be forced to downgrade internet speeds and hardware
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, if PBMA lost it's E-Rate funding we would be forced to majorly downgrade our internet speeds and would not be able to afford the hardware to upgrade it in the future. This would majorly hinder our ability to educate students.
